title.en: GPT Image 2.5 Flare & Sunburst Tier Routes Live
title.zh: GPT Image 2.5 Flare 与 Sunburst 档位路由上线

summary.en: Dedicated tier routes `gpt-image-2.5-flare` and `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst` are now available for volume image generation on OmniMux.
summary.zh: 图像生成特惠档模型 `gpt-image-2.5-flare` 与低价档模型 `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst` 现已接入 OmniMux 提供生图调用。

body.en:
## GPT Image Tiers

OmniMux now supports dedicated tier routing models `gpt-image-2.5-flare` and `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst` under the standard image generation endpoint.

### Model specification

- **Endpoint:** `POST /v1/images/generations`
- **Authentication:** Bearer token (`sk-...`)
- **Tier models:** `gpt-image-2.5-flare` (discounted tier), `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst` (economy tier)
- **Parameters:** Fully compatible with baseline `gpt-image-2.5`

### Request example

```bash
curl --request POST \
  --url https://api.omnimux.ai/v1/images/generations \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer sk-...' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "model": "gpt-image-2.5-flare",
    "prompt": "A clean studio product photograph on white background",
    "n": 1
  }'
```

Parameter details are documented in the [GPT Image Reference](/en/api-reference/image-series/gpt-image/generate).
body.zh:
## GPT Image 计费档位模型

OmniMux 标准生图端点现已支持专属档位模型 `gpt-image-2.5-flare` 与 `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst`。

### 接口规范

- **调用端点：** `POST /v1/images/generations`
- **鉴权方式：** Bearer 令牌鉴权（`sk-...`）
- **档位模型：** `gpt-image-2.5-flare`（特惠档）、`gpt-image-2.5-sunburst`（经济档）
- **调用参数：** 与基准版 `gpt-image-2.5` 保持完全一致

### 请求示例

```bash
curl --request POST \
  --url https://api.omnimux.ai/v1/images/generations \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer sk-...' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "model": "gpt-image-2.5-flare",
    "prompt": "白底商品棚拍静物摄影图",
    "n": 1
  }'
```

完整参数规范请参阅 [GPT Image 接口文档](/zh/api-reference/image-series/gpt-image/generate)。
